name: ps-golden-driver
description: Drives Pokemon Showdown sim under a fixed PRNG seed against a fully-specified scripted battle (teams + per-turn actions) and writes a JSON ground-truth log: protocol events (damage/faint/status/boost/move/switch with raw HP) plus RNG events (crit/damage-roll/percent-roll/range). Consumed by vgc-engine-golden as the differential oracle.
